models.name: Claude Fable 5.1
models.description: Anthropic's most capable model for demanding reasoning and long-horizon agentic work, with a 1M context window. Successor to Fable 5 with cheaper cache reads; forced tool_choice is not supported.

models.name: Claude Haiku 5.5
models.description: Anthropic's Claude Haiku 5.5: the fast, low-cost Claude for high-volume classification, routing, extraction and sub-agent work, with a 1M context window, 128K output and effort-controlled adaptive thinking; prompts over 100K tokens are billed at the higher long-context rate.

models.name: Gemini 2.5 Flash
models.description: Google's fast and cost-effective model with a 1M token context window. Best for high-volume, low-latency tasks and agentic use cases.

details.notes: You do not need to add this model manually, simply choose `Gemini 2.5 Flash` in Cursor and it will automatically route to Concentrate AI. It may show 'Reconnecting...' message in Cursor chat window periodically. This is an expected bug with no functional impact.
